before: In a document that balances single-byte and double-byte widths, every space keeps its face advance, and a justified line in a modern compatibility mode shrinks every inter-word space to keep the next word.
after: With w:balanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth, a space beside East Asian text and each space of a run of spaces take the balanced width in every mode, and justified and distributed lines keep that width while their other spaces shrink. Without the setting, layout is unchanged.
reason: Only derived layout changes. Canonical OOXML, source offsets, operations, and collaboration formats remain unchanged.
